description: Expand the Word Wizard word bank from ~30 to roughly 60-90 real, grade-appropriate words across the three difficulty tiers, each with a sensible emoji so the 'name the picture' type never shows a blank. Keep the WordEntry(word, emoji) shape and the easy/medium/hard + forDifficulty/allWords API unchanged so the generator and the Batch-2 TTS keep working. Independent of FEAT-003; depends on FEAT-001 only in that the generator structural tests must still pass against the larger bank.
steps: Edit lib/games/word_wizard/models/word_bank.dart: grow easy (CVC / grade-1 sight words), medium (grade-2), and hard (grade-3) to ~20-30 entries each (~60-90 total). Real words only, no nonsense/placeholders, age-appropriate 6-9. Every word MUST have a fitting, reasonably distinct emoji; a word with no sensible emoji is left out rather than given a blank/duplicate-looking picture. Keep words plain lowercase letters (no spaces/punctuation) so missingLetter/correctSpelling/TTS all work and length >= 2.

Do NOT change WordQuestion or the generator's logic in this feature. Confirm _distinctWords can still fill 4 options per tier (each tier has >=4 entries — trivially satisfied) and that namePicture/missingLetter/correctSpelling still build.

OPTIONAL 4th question type (rhyme/first-sound): add ONLY if it fits the existing WordQuestion model with zero churn. If it would need new model fields or generator restructuring, do NOT add it — instead add a short `// Future work:` comment in lib/games/word_wizard/services/word_generator.dart describing the idea. Record the decision in findings.
Run build web and the full test suite (the FEAT-001 generator tests now exercise the larger bank). Commit on feature/review-improvements.
acceptance_criteria: lib/games/word_wizard/models/word_bank.dart contains roughly 60-90 real words total across easy/medium/hard, each paired with a fitting emoji, with the public API (easy/medium/hard/forDifficulty/allWords) unchanged.
`& "$env:USERPROFILE\flutter\bin\flutter.bat" test` passes (including FEAT-001's generator tests against the expanded bank).
All three existing question types still work for the new words, and spokenWord (TTS target) resolves to the full correct word for new entries.
findings: Expanded lib/games/word_wizard/models/word_bank.dart from 30 to 75 real, age-appropriate words (25 easy CVC/grade-1, 25 medium grade-2, 25 hard grade-3), each with a fitting, distinct emoji. All words are plain lowercase letters, length >= 2, no spaces/punctuation. The WordEntry(word, emoji) shape and the public API (easy/medium/hard/forDifficulty/allWords) are unchanged, and WordQuestion + the generator logic were NOT touched, so namePicture/missingLetter/correctSpelling and the TTS spokenWord target all keep working; each tier has 25 entries so _distinctWords trivially fills 4 options. OPTIONAL 4th question type: NOT added. A rhyme or first-sound type cannot be added with zero churn to the current WordQuestion model/generator (rhyme needs a rhyme-group field on WordEntry; first-sound needs initial-letter-aware distractors), so per the step it was deferred and documented as a `// Future work:` comment above generateOne() in word_generator.dart. Verification: `flutter build web` prints `Built build\web`; `flutter test` passes all 45 tests (including FEAT-001's generators_test against the larger bank).
